name: Accordion
description: Zero-JavaScript FAQ accordion built on <details> and <summary>.
notes: Native <details> is keyboard and screen-reader accessible out of the box, and browser find-in-page can search inside closed panels.

Can I use these components commercially?

Yes. Copy them into any project, paid or free, with no attribution required.

Do I need a build step?

No. The HTML/CSS versions work in a plain file. Framework versions drop into any React, Vue or Svelte project.

How do I change the colors?

Edit the design tokens. Every component reads from the same CSS custom properties.
